steps.text: Welcome to your first shift! Drag anywhere to drive your pompwagen.
A supplier offer! Your first delivery is FREE — accept it!
The truck is at the dock. Stand on the UNLOAD pad to take a pallet.
Drive to the rack and store the pallet. Repeat for all 3 pallets.
A customer order! FreshMart needs 2 pallets — you have 3 ✔. Accept!
Load their truck: take pallets from the rack to the LOAD pad.
+€28 profit! The leftover pallet stays in stock for the next customer.
Now expand: stand on the NEW RACK ROW pad until it's paid.
You're the boss now. Keep the trucks moving!
